quest.title: Thief-Catcher
quest.description: The storm has just ended, and Cyrus from the Adventurers' Guild is currently planning to clear the Treasure Hoarders out...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x16000, Guide to Resistance x2

talks.objective: Defeat the Treasure Hoarders near to the Dawn Winery
Defeat the Treasure Hoarders guarding the camps

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You're back. Have you wiped their camps out yet?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: As I thought, it was child's play for you, Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I will admit that these Treasure Hoarders are quite persistent. Everyone was running for cover during the storm. They, by contrast, had the daring to run out and steal things.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If only they had used that perseverance for something proper instead...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmph, these Treasure Hoarders... What a persistent pack of rats they are.
